name: Ronald Humphrey
summary: An unbeaten American welterweight from ATT Atlanta (5-0, age 26) who won his contract on the Contender Series in August with a R1 submission. UFC debut.

how_they_fight.Grappling: R1 submission on the Contender Series.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has not been past R2 as a pro.

patterns: Every win a finish, four in R1

news.text: Booked for his UFC debut against Nikolay Veretennikov.

sources.title: Contender Series standout books Octagon debut for UFC 335
